The problem is: "What is the chance that x is greater than 54 when a normal distribution has a mean of 43 and sigma of 4"

This sounds like a "right-tail area" problem. So the answer would be in this format:

A: { problem: "right-tail-area", params: {x:54, mean:43, sigma:4} }

To solve this type of problem, you would:
1. Calculate the z-score: z = (x - μ) / σ
2. Use a z-table or statistical software to find the right-tail probability
3. In this case: z = (54 - 43) / 4 = 2.75
4. The right-tail probability would correspond to the area to the right of z = 2.75
